content: Approve with fix 6ca299ef23. No real diagnostic uses E0000: its only occurrence is the negated SM_diagnostic argument in native-semantics.coax, a "not this code" stand-in that is never reported. The blanket discard in tools.py could still hide a future E0000, so the check now skips only that argument; an E0000 in src/ or lib/ fails it (probed both). E0706 is real (shader.cpp, two error_at sites) and its explanation matches. verify.cpp keeps the check name and counterexample in --json text and moves them to notes only under --diagnostics json. diagnostics_json.py 7/7; its .txt records match the pre-flag compiler byte for byte apart from the stale-compiler note. Full tests/run.sh rc 0; tools.py 15/15.
